meals.name: Lentil Soup with Sausage, Chard and Garlic
ings: 4 large links (1 lb) sweet Italian sausage
Kosher salt and red pepper flakes
2 cups brown lentils, sorted and rinsed
3–4 cups shredded Swiss chard or kale
steps: Heat 2 Tbsp olive oil in large pot over medium-high. Add sausage, brown 5 min. Add onion, celery, carrots, 2 garlic cloves, salt, optional pepper flakes; cook 5 min.
Add lentils, bay leaves, tomatoes, broth, salt and pepper. Simmer until lentils are tender, ~40 min.
Add chard, cook until tender, a few minutes. Discard bay leaves.
In small skillet, heat remaining garlic in remaining olive oil until softened. Drizzle over bowls with Romano.
meals.label: Meal A

meals.name: Lemon Dill Salmon with Roasted Broccoli & Brown Rice
ings: 1 lemon, half sliced thin, half for juice
2 pouches microwaveable brown rice (8.5 oz each)
Optional: lemon zest, fresh dill, flaky salt to finish
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a large sheet pan with foil.
Toss broccoli florets with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread on the sheet pan. Roast 10 minutes.
Pat salmon dry. Rub with olive oil, garlic powder, dill, salt, and pepper. Place on the sheet pan alongside the broccoli. Lay lemon slices on top of each fillet.
Roast 12–14 minutes until salmon flakes easily and broccoli edges are lightly charred.
Microwave brown rice pouches per package directions (about 90 seconds). Fluff and serve.
Squeeze fresh lemon over everything before serving. Finish with a pinch of flaky salt if you have it.
meals.note: 💡 The lemon slices on top perfume the fish as it roasts. If fillets are thick (over 1 inch), add 2 minutes. Broccoli should be in a single layer for good char — use two pans if needed.
meals.label: Meal B

meals.name: Best Lasagna
ings: 1 lb ground beef (or turkey, or ½ beef ½ mild sausage)
1½ tsp kosher salt, ¾ tsp black pepper
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Boil salted water; cook noodles al dente ~8 min. Drain, rinse, separate.
Brown beef with onion and garlic over medium-high, ~8 min. Stir in tomato paste, 1 min. Add tomatoes, salt, pepper, seasoning, sugar. Simmer covered 15–20 min.
Mix ricotta, egg, ¾ cup Parmesan, remaining salt and pepper.
In 9×13 dish: 1 cup sauce, noodles, 1½ cups sauce, ¼ ricotta mix, 1¼ cups mozzarella. Repeat 3 more times. Top with remaining sauce, mozzarella, Parmesan.
Cover loosely with foil. Bake 30 min. Uncover, bake 20 more min. Rest 5–10 min before serving.
